content: {"episode_id":"ep-05058","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry) was ordered because the patient presents with recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and near-syncope (R55), raising concern for intermittent arrhythmia. The patient also has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73), and prolonged mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptoms with potential cardiac rhythm disturbances. The service was therefore medically necessary as documented in the submitted clinical indication note, and we request reconsideration of the CO-197 denial."}
